summary.name: Chronicle
summary.one_liner: Chronicle is an AI presentation maker for creating professional, interactive slide decks aimed at business teams.
use_cases: building branded decks across a team
visualizing data and charts in slides
exporting slides to PowerPoint for further editing
summary.what_it_does: Chronicle is a web-based AI presentation tool for building professional slide decks. It supports charts, graphs, metrics and tables, and says you can embed hundreds of tools. Teams can set brand fonts, colors and visual rules so slides stay consistent, and can keep full control over layouts. Decks can be exported to PPT and edited further there. The page also lists real-time collaboration with shared templates and permission management, plus a library of templates and the option to upload your own.
notable: Brand guidelines applied to fonts, colors and visual rules across slides
Export to PPT for continued editing
Templates credited to designers from Apple, McKinsey, BCG and IDEO, plus option to upload your own
caveats: Listing tags it as free, but the page text itself does not state pricing tiers
Page makes marketing claims (e.g. 5000+ teams) without independent verification
